name: Finnhub
tagline: Real-time stock, forex, crypto, and company fundamentals API for markets data
description: Finnhub provides market data APIs for stocks, forex, crypto, company fundamentals, news, and economic indicators. Developers authenticate with a free API key and call REST endpoints for quotes, candles, financials, and more; WebSocket streaming is also available for real-time trades.

auth.details: API key via token query parameter (?token=YOUR_API_KEY) or X-Finnhub-Token header; free self-serve signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free tier available; exact current limits vary by plan — verify on pricing page
pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans available for higher rate limits and premium data

rate_limits: Published limits depend on plan; free tier has request-per-minute limits
use_cases: get real-time stock quote for a ticker
fetch historical OHLCV candles for a symbol
get market news for a company or general market
